name: synthetic_execpolicy_nested_alts_degradation
description: Pins CURRENT parser behavior: pattern=["git", ["push", "fetch"]] silently degrades to prefix ["git"] because the pattern regex stops at the first ']' and the nested-alternatives token is dropped. The rule therefore prompts on EVERY git command, not just push/fetch. The doc comment in src/execpolicy.rs and the unit test test_parse_policy_with_alternatives suggest narrower intent; if the parser is fixed, this fixture must be updated to the narrowed expectations.
